description: Seconds each suite takes, for run.mjs --shard (shard.mjs). Measured from the CI logs of successful runs on 2026-11-17 (go-binary jobs 134236082793, 134237980844, 134239790894, 134252363752, 134256737596; e2e jobs 134211201211, 134244575748, 134261766317): the time between a suite's --- line and the next, less the runner's request-budget waits. Each value is the larger of the two targets' medians, rounded up, at least 1. A suite missing here weighs shard.mjs DEFAULT_WEIGHT. Re-measure when a suite grows or shrinks by a minute.
